title: Zoomable Mandelbrot
why: Pure numerical code plus an interaction model. Wrong escape-time maths produces something that still renders but is visibly not a Mandelbrot set, so it fails loudly rather than silently.

title: Pelican on a bicycle
why: Simon Willison's benchmark. A scene that cannot exist in the training data, so the model has to compose it: valid SVG syntax, bicycle structure, pelican anatomy, and the spatial relation between them.

title: Solar system
